pr_body: # ↪️ Pull Request I'll add some comments to the code with questions to the rest of the team. Based on the work done in #2579 Closes #2144 Also updates the error pages: 500: 404: ## 🚨 Test instructions Run the hmr-react example or look at the passing integration tests. ## ✔️ PR Todo - [x] Get Dev Server to work - [x] Get HMR Server to work - [x] Get HMR Runtime to be added to the bundle - [x] Update Dev Server tests and get them to pass - [x] Update HMR Tests - [x] Get HMR Runtime to work properly - [x] Get HMR Tests to Pass - [x] Filter out non browser assets (HMRServer) - [x] Filter out assets that apply to a different env (Runtime)
pr_comments:
All the hmr and dev-server tests pass now, except for some minor things like emitting too much assets. Gotta figure out how to get only the truly changed assets and filter out non-browser targets.

Also the hmr tests don't really wanna run if they all run after one another, perhaps there should be a way to stop the watcher, server, ... in the tests after each test?
I don't think hmr is responsible for the freezing of the tests though. It throws buildAbort errors and some other things so I think it's a core issue. Which I don't really wanna touch in this PR to prevent merge conflicts as this PR has been open for a lil while.

issue_context.title: Parcel 2: Server
issue_context.body: The Server from Parcel 1 should be extracted into a separate package in the monorepo for Parcel 2, as `@parcel/server`. This should include both the dev web server as well as the HMR web socket server. All utils related only to servers should be moved into this package. Parcel 1 should also be updated to use this package.
comments:
Typo:
> into a separate package in the monorepo for Parcel **Two**
Hi, can I pick this up? I am new to OSS, so any pointers on how to start?

Also, what should we do about multiple entry points here? We don’t currently handle that case in parcel 1 but if a user has multiple html files as entries, we should pick the one named `index.html` by default.
